items.claim: Aspen has a long jab, works the body, and throws a good front kick with high volume.
items.quote: He's got a long jab. He's going to stick that jab out there. He's going to work the body. He's even got a good front kick... And he's got good volume to go with it.

items.claim: Aspen exhibits tall man defense and tends to lean back to avoid strikes.
items.quote: Now, he does have tall man defense. That's a problem. He does do the the whole lean back thing

items.claim: Pat only throws single punches occasionally, which plays into Aspen's tall man defense.
items.quote: the good thing for Aspen is Pat only throws maybe one punch here and there. And to get a guy with the tall man defense who's doing this, you kind of got to throw two or three

items.claim: Aspen has decent enough takedown defense.
items.quote: He's got decent enough takedown defense of his own.

items.claim: Aspen has good cardio for a heavyweight and maintains his output even when fatigued.
items.quote: He's got good cardio uh for a heavyweight... even if he has tired, he's still he's still putting out output.

items.claim: Pat does not do much in fights and lacks success in the UFC.
items.quote: Pat just doesn't do anything. Um I don't know that he I don't know that he has a whole lot of luck in the UFC.

items.claim: Tai Miller has a record of 4-0 with one no contest in his last five fights and is undefeated at 7-0 overall.
items.quote: we got Ty Miller coming in 40 and a no contest in his last five fights. He's undefeated at 7-0 overall.

items.claim: Billy Goff has gone three and two in his last five fights.
items.quote: Billy Goff is three and two in his last five fights.

items.claim: Billy Goff is a good striker with a high pace, high volume, and a preference for dirty boxing range.
items.quote: Billy Goth, good striker. Dude's got heck of a pace. He's going to put it on you... His striking is a lot of volume and it's a lot of him just working in that dirty boxing range.

items.claim: Billy Goff's striking defense is not great.
items.quote: His striking defense isn't great, but he's putting out a lot of output.

items.claim: Billy Goff is tough, durable, and forces opponents to work in the dirty boxing range.
items.quote: He's in general pretty tough, pretty durable. He's the type of guy that's going to make you work to get away from him up up in that that dirty boxing

items.claim: Billy Goff has decent grappling with good takedowns and cage pushing ability.
items.quote: He does have decent grappling and can mix in some takedowns. They're pretty good, right? Pretty good. Good cage push.

items.claim: Tai Miller wants to use rangy boxing and keep opponents at the end of his punches using his jab.
items.quote: Ty Miller wants to use his boxing as well, but it's more of that rangy boxing. He wants you at the end of his punches. He's going to come forward and he's going to stick his jab
